## NHS Services Map

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load the data
Book3 <- read_excel("C:/Users/amywa/OneDrive/Book3.xlsx")

# Prepare the data
nhs_services <- Book3 %>%
  mutate(
    Latitude  = as.numeric(Latitude),
    Longitude = as.numeric(Longitude),
    Type      = factor(Type, levels = c("A&E", "MIU")),
    color     = ifelse(Type == "A&E", "red", "#609c91")
  )

# Fit bounds
bounds <- nhs_services %>%
  summarise(
    minLat = min(Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxLat = max(Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    minLng = min(Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxLng = max(Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Create the map
leaflet(nhs_services,
        options = leafletOptions(
          zoomControl = FALSE,
          dragging = FALSE,
          scrollWheelZoom = FALSE
        )) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Longitude,
    lat = ~Latitude,
    radius = 6,
    color = ~color,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~Service,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "bold", padding = "3px 6px"),
      textsize = "12px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = bounds$minLng,
    lat1 = bounds$minLat,
    lng2 = bounds$maxLng,
    lat2 = bounds$maxLat
  )
```
